questions.stem: The drug of choice for the treatment of group C or G streptococcal infections is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Penicillin

Penicillin is an antibiotic that belongs to a larger family of drugs known as beta-lactam antibiotics. Penicillins work by binding to molecules on the walls of bacteria called peptidoglycan.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 770

questions.stem: Among the following options, Spiramycin belongs to which class?
questions.solutionHtml:
Macrolide

Macrolides are a class of natural products that consist of a large macrocyclic lactone ring to which one or more deoxy sugars, usually cladinose and desosamine, may be attached. The lactone rings are usually 14-, 15-, or 16-membered. Macrolides belong to the polyketide class of natural products.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 805

questions.stem: Treatment for gonococcal and non-gonococcal cervicitis is?
questions.solutionHtml:
Azithromycin
  • Single drug treatment for gonococcal and non-gonococcal cervicitis among the options is azithromycin
  • Azithromycin is effective for both gonococcal and non-gonococcal cervicitis (caused by mycoplasma and chlamydia)


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 804

questions.stem: Among the following options which one is the DOC for diphtheria carriers is
questions.solutionHtml:
Erythromycin

Erythromycin is an antibiotic used for the treatment of a number of bacterial infections. This includes respiratory tract infections, skin infections, chlamydia infections, pelvic inflammatory disease, and syphilis. It may also be used during pregnancy to prevent Group B streptococcal infection



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 803

questions.stem: Which of the following drug doesn’t bind to 30S bacterial ribosomal?
questions.solutionHtml:
Clindamycin

Clindamycin is an antibiotic medication used for the treatment of a number of bacterial infections, including osteomyelitis (bone) or joint infections, pelvic inflammatory disease, strep throat, pneumonia, acute otitis media (middle ear infections), and endocarditis



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 805

questions.stem: Which of the following antimicrobials has neuromuscular blockade properties?
questions.solutionHtml:
Streptomycin

Streptomycin is an antibiotic used in the treatment of tuberculosis, in combination with other medicines. It works by stopping the growth of tubercular bacteria. Rarely, it may also be used to treat some other types of infections.
